bias.en: Downtrend · SAR flipped bearish, near the Nov 5 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 抛物线 SAR 转为看空，接近 11月5日低点

read.en: TSMC fell 3.7% on Nov 17 to $359.69, trading $353.50–373.05 on heavy volume (1.65x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($390.1), 10-day ($386.0), 30-day ($414.9), 100-day ($424.0) and 200-day ($403.4). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 17 ($416.80), and RSI is 35.7.

The drop broke the $368–372.7 supports (Nov 6 low, Jul 29 low), now resistance, and turned the SAR bearish; the $353.50 low stopped just above the Nov 5 low ($351.19). Resistance is $368–373, then $375.4–380.8 and $385.5–390.1 (Nov 16 high, 10-day, 5-day). Support is $351.2–353.5, then $338.6–341.8 (early-April lows and closes) and $326.8 (Apr 2 low). A close above $373 would target $375–381; below $351.2, $340.

r.en: Nov 6 low $367.95 and Jul 29 low $372.72, lost; Nov 16 low $372.46; Nov 17 high $373.05

s.en: Nov 5 low $351.19 and close $353.10; Nov 17 low $353.50
